Full reverse engineering done 2026-10-24 (independent analysis).

IDENTITY: This file is stage 2 of the "DuperScreenApi" stack. It is NOT SilentNet. Family name: "8weeksaverage".

BUILD: Maven fat jar, JDK 17, built 2026-10-06. Main class: com.internal.reflect.Main. The jar stores class data in directory-type entries. This stops simple extraction tools.

DELIVERY: Stage 1 is "sylant.class" (sha256 starts a7362736). Stage 1 reads Polygon contract 0xf478d0Ef5A1b8EdbEDB0a05b78C46418cE49813C, topic 0xc1c82a5983e686a8, through public RPC mirrors. The contract data gives plainraw.com paste links. The pastes give these URLs: files.8weeksaverage.xyz/sylant.class and files.8weeksaverage.xyz/sodium.jar.

CONFIG TRANSPORT: The file gets its config from three sources: (1) a native key stub assets/nt.bin, XOR key 0x5F; (2) a chess.com game collection, FEN data, ID 431165a6-4729-11f1-8792-778f0ac3018e, now private; (3) Polygon logs with AES-GCM data. Decrypted config (2026-10-24): relay wss://ws-relay.8weeksaverage.xyz; auth_key e7c9b2f4a1d3e5f6b8c9a0f1e2d3c4b5a6f7e8c9d0b1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d011ff; Supabase project iikbktkjpnfdwpmambcl.supabase.co (deleted); CDN files.8weeksaverage.xyz (helix.jar, APO_2.exe, versionpp.txt); update channel plainraw.com/raw/e6b21f3c23e2.

CAPABILITIES: Remote administration and data theft. Screenshare, webcam and microphone relay over WebRTC. Keylogger. Full-screen lock with input block. Data theft from browsers (memory read via handle duplication), Discord, Minecraft (Dawn Launcher accounts), Roblox, Steam, Telegram tdata, crypto wallets. UAC bypass. The process sets itself as a critical process: stop it and Windows shows a blue screen. The file copies itself into the Minecraft mods folder (ModInjector). VM detection with 8 checks.

INFRASTRUCTURE: All 8weeksaverage.xyz names (Porkbun, domain registered 2026-10-04) resolve to one host: 202.170.75.137 (AS219067).

STATUS: The Supabase backend is dead (project deleted). The relay host still answers.
